applicationFee.note: Not currently enrolled: $50; currently enrolled UNL students: $25. Central office does not issue waivers, but departments may cover fees; contact program before payment. No citizenship restriction stated on this route; international applicants should confirm eligibility. No departmental waiver guarantee established.

english.note: Central current TOEFL minimum 4 after January 21, 2026; no department-specific new-scale equivalent verified. English-medium accredited bachelor’s or advanced degree exempts testing. Scores valid two years; central ESL 887 placement may still apply based on scores.

documents: Unofficial transcripts/mark sheets from all institutions, plus international degree certificates/diplomas and certified English translations
One-page personal statement on teaching/research/volunteer experience
requirements.note: Official records required after admission. F/J visa applicants must provide financial information. Students encouraged to contact faculty regarding research/funding; admission model not directly established.

funding.note: Engineering assistantships competitively awarded through departments with admission review; funding limited. Published undated minimum monthly stipend $2, 600 (some existing grant-supported appointments may vary), up to 12 credits tuition remission/semester and reduced-cost health insurance. No all-admitted guarantee.
